title: Apple GPU M=1 projection baseline characterization
question: What synchronized operation latency does the one-output-per-SIMD-group Apple GPU projection baseline establish for Q, KV, hot QKV, and rotating 24-layer QKV decode workloads?

scope.boundary: No M>1 prefill implementation or conclusion.

baseline.lane_work: Each of 32 lanes accumulates every 32nd K element in FP32.
baseline.reduction: One warp.sum per output dot product.

correctness.authority: tests/test_linear.mojo plus the benchmark's untimed all-one-output gate
correctness.test_command: MODULAR_DEBUG=device-sync-mode uv run --locked mojo run -I src -I tests tests/test_linear.mojo
correctness.gate: Every output in every workload must equal exact BF16 one before timing.

workloads.semantic_role: one hot query, key, and value layer

workloads.role: primary optimization decision workload in EXP-0005

measurement_protocol.decisive_command: uv run --locked python benchmarks/run_linear.py --blocks 4 --experiment-id EXP-0004 --run-id EXP-0004-RUN-001 --recorded --output-dir <absolute-external-path>/EXP-0004-RUN-001
measurement_protocol.timing_boundary: All enqueues belonging to one declared workload iteration through the GPU-aware bencher completion boundary.
measurement_protocol.environment: Clean immutable commit, AC power, no reported thermal or performance warning, Apple GPU plus Metal runtime identity, and MODULAR_DEBUG unset.

traffic_accounting.allocated_footprint: Exact live BF16 buffer allocation for the workload.
traffic_accounting.program_requested_traffic: Source-level BF16 input, weight, bias, and output accesses, including repeated input reads across Q/K/V and layers.
traffic_accounting.observed_hardware_traffic: Not inferred. Requires a named profiler counter and valid receipt-bound capture.

profiling_protocol.binary_location: External path with SHA-256 provenance; launch only from verified owner-only /private/tmp staging.
profiling_protocol.capture_rule: Use short receipt-bound captures. Treat profiler failure as a tooling limitation and make no mechanism claim.

completion_conditions: All correctness and runner parser tests pass.
Four recorded blocks pass cleanliness, power, thermal, device, order, and sample-count gates.
Each workload retains 40 valid latency samples.
Baseline profile attempts are receipt-bound or explicitly recorded as unavailable.
nonclaims: No end-to-end model, decoder-block, time-per-output-token, or tokens-per-second result.
No measured hardware bandwidth claim from source-derived bytes.
No claim that the baseline is optimal.

profiles.evidence_boundary: Single baseline-only, device-wide counter captures. They characterize the measured windows but do not establish a candidate mechanism or a causal cache/bandwidth limiter.

decision.reason: The baseline timing and bounded Q/ring24 profiles are complete. EXP-0005 separately rejected the two-output candidate under the preregistered primary-workload and no-regression rule.
